scope:
Differentiate an accepted actual-tail problem in physical design controls.

At the unchanged accepted raw state, the fixed-metric full Jacobian has all
core coefficients as boundary unknowns.  Delta/LB/vp, and optional other
prefix-only controls, enter as external forcing columns.  A 3x3 exchange
then prescribes actual c2/c4/c6 while solving for those three controls.

The recorded complete nonlinear-tail height Jacobian is used only at its
exact recorded boundary H.  There is no Node worker, new tail solve, BVP
continuation, or new accepted surface.  The original actual/fixed loader and
boundary Jacobian are reused, with a local affine tail tangent for this
derivative calculation only.  --metadata-only does not import NumPy or load
any Flow; it checks the linked input data and complete H byte identity.

input_identity.scope: Input identity check only, with no Flow, RHS, Jacobian assembly, Node or BVP.

tail_jacobian_method.slope: analytic actual shooting tangent plus exact cut chain rule
tail_jacobian_method.meanSlopeCorrection: analytic actual shooting tangent plus exact cut chain rule
tail_jacobian_method.second: source symmetric difference on actual tangent graph
tail_jacobian_method.meanSecondCorrection: source symmetric difference on actual tangent graph

disk_response_adapter.scope:
Optional disk storage for the original accepted fixed-g control response.

The input must still be a genuinely checked fixed view with M core parameters.
This does not relabel an M+3 design endpoint or create a new nonlinear solution.
All original complete-H identities, full-field forcing, half-step checks and
original matrix residual checks remain. Every QR solve additionally receives
the production backend's complete streamed numerical backward-error gate.

explicit_transforms.after:
from strong_disk_actual_backend import install_disk_backend
    disk_runtime = install_disk_backend(bounded, prefix, DISK_WRAPPER_CONFIGURATION)
    blocks = bounded.blocks
baseline_cfg.get(field,0.) if field in ('initial_speed_pulse','initial_speed_frontload') else baseline_cfg[field]

pulse_hook.install(value)
                    import strong_monotone_initial_speed as frontload_hook
                    frontload_hook.install(value)

initial_speed_pulse_adapter.scope:
Add the explicit initial-speed-pulse direction to the original actual response.

This is still the original accepted fixed-view full-field Jacobian response,
with disk storage, full backward checks, and half-step forcing checks.  The
provider hook is installed on the actual nested root-dual provider loader.
At an absent/zero pulse the original baseline geometry is delegated exactly;
nonzero external perturbations are new metric directions, never refinements.
No altered BVP or nonlinear acceptance is introduced.  A saved M+3 endpoint
must undergo the original genuine fixed-view conversion before using this.

monotone_initial_speed_adapter.scope:
Compare pulse and monotone first-piece directions in one actual fixed-J solve.

The input must already be a genuinely verified actual fixed-view endpoint.
Both external columns use the complete saved field, all core coefficients,
the original physical full-H boundary, full stream backward error and half
step forcing checks. This is a derivative computation, never a new BVP.
All nonzero front-loaded reloads use the explicit monotone provider hook.

first_append_anchor_response.scope:
Original full-J responses with the corrected first-append provider anchor.

General mode preserves the original complete response calculation. Explicit
--only-missing-from instead computes only frontload and vd at the exact old
accepted q122 state, retaining the six successful original columns in their
separate recovery packet. It does not pretend the old half arrays existed.
Every newly evaluated external column keeps the original full/half forcing,
complete matrix solve/backward checks and original 2e-4 external half gate.
Both new half directions and forcing vectors are saved for faithful recovery.

provider_source_identity.only_changed_expression: first nonzero Hermite physical_piece a0 argument: segment[a0] -> self.aend

field_parameter_layout: Saved fixed-core layout. Tail entries of every tangent array are all-core parameter derivatives, not delta/LB/vp design offsets.
limitations: The stored finite D-N derivative is used only at its exact complete H; it is not a new nonlinear tail solve.
These are local derivatives; a finite step needs a new actual nonlinear coupled BVP and geometry audit.
The old triple warm launcher cannot consume this all-core parameter layout without explicit conversion.

samechart_response_adapter.scope:
Restore the recorded numerical reference before the unchanged actual response.

The accepted fixed physical profile and raw state remain unchanged. The
original raw reader is still authoritative for every physical, layout,
tolerance, context, chunk and parameter identity. This wrapper only restores
the old numerical knots that an ordinary newly constructed Fixed object would
otherwise replace by final-profile normalized knots. No worker is permitted by
the original response entry; all full-field, half-step and backward gates stay.
